iut_type: Already-Included Bluetooth module QDID whose Listing Owner (manufacturer) changes -- effect on downstream registrations referencing that QDID
customer_question: For our device currently registered with Bluetooth Core Specification 4.2, the Bluetooth module manufacturer is changing from Taiyo Yuden to Kaga FEI, but the QDID itself doesn't change (97470). Does this require any change-application procedure to our SIG registration?
question_variants: If a referenced module's manufacturer changes but keeps the same QDID, do all downstream registrations referencing that QDID need to be updated?
Does a module's Listing Owner change automatically propagate to or invalidate registrations that already Include that module's QDID?
actual_issue: The customer's underlying Bluetooth module supplier was transitioning from Taiyo Yuden to Kaga FEI for the same QDID (97470), and the customer wanted to know whether this manufacturer change required any update to their own device's existing SIG registration, which references that QDID.
plain_english_explanation: In this specific case, the QDID's Listing Owner was also transitioning from Taiyo Yuden to Kaga FEI, and critically, both companies' module model names were registered together in that QDID's own Product List. Because both manufacturer names appear in the Product List of the referenced QDID itself, a downstream registration that references (Includes) that QDID requires no procedure or update on its own part, regardless of which of the two listed manufacturers actually supplied the physical module. The downstream registration's validity is tied to the QDID reference, not to which specific manufacturer among those listed under that QDID's Product List actually produced the unit.
consultant_answer: In your case, no procedure is needed -- the QDID's Listing Owner is also transitioning from Taiyo Yuden to Kaga FEI, and both companies' module model names are registered together under that QDID's own Product List. Since your registration references that QDID, it remains valid regardless of which of the two listed manufacturers actually supplied your specific module.
decision_logic: When a referenced module's manufacturer changes for an already-Included QDID, check whether the new manufacturer's model name has also been added to that QDID's own Product List (alongside the original manufacturer) -- if so, downstream registrations referencing that QDID require no update or procedure, since validity is tied to the QDID reference itself rather than to a single specific manufacturer's identity.
final_recommendation: When a customer asks about a referenced component's manufacturer transition, check the QDID's own Product List for whether both the outgoing and incoming manufacturer's model names are listed together before concluding any update procedure is or isn't needed on the downstream registration.
risk_if_done_wrong: A customer might needlessly initiate an update or re-registration process out of caution when none is actually required, or conversely assume no action is ever needed for manufacturer transitions without checking whether the new manufacturer is actually listed under the referenced QDID.
